change_openclaw_workspace_prompt: First of all, change your workspace directory to: "<workspace_path>/", read and write files only in this directory!!!
opencode_evaluation_prompt_cn: 请参考位于 "<task_description_file>" 的AI Agent任务描述以及评分标准。AI Agent的运行结果位于目录 "<task_output_dir>" 中。请根据评分标准，准确评价AI Agent的运行输出结果。如果任务描述及评分标准 md 文件中包含带有代码段的 "Automated Checks" 章节，请从中提取评价代码并运行获得结果，然后调整成0-1的分数，作为automated_score。如果有LLM Judge Rubric章节，请按照要求和评分标准对结果打分，然后调整成0-1的分数，作为llm_judge_score。计算得分时注意是否有分项的权重。最后，如果文件中的评分权重grading_weights已经给出，请根据权重计算出任务完成的总得分（automated_score * grading_weights.automated + llm_judge_score * grading_weights.llm_judge），如果仅有一种评分标准，则直接使用该评分标准计算总分。请谨记在输出的最后一行用这个格式加上总得分信息与满分（通常为1.0）信息： "TASK_SCORE=score, FULL_SCORE=full_score"。
invoke_skill_prompt: If exist, invoke the agent skill "<skill_name>" to complete the task.
summarize_skill_prompt: Review and summarize key processes and points for completing this task into an agent skill named "<skill_name>" and save it to "<skill_path>/<skill_name>/SKILL.md". A sample skill format can be found in "<skill_path>/sample_skill/SKILL.md".
naive_skill_evolution_prompt: Refer to the task completion evaluation in the "<task_evaluation_file>" file, generate or update the agent skill in "<skill_path>/<skill_name>" with key processes and points for completing this task.
naive_skill_evolution_prompt0: Please refer to the evaluation "<task_evaluation_file>" of the task you just accomplished and update the skill you created in "<skill_path>/<skill_name>"
